incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark, swirling cloud mass dominates the sky above a rural landscape with trees and houses, suggesting a severe weather event or fire.

observations.description: Large, dark, billowing smoke plumes rising from the ground on the right side of the image, mixing with lighter grey clouds.
Dark coniferous trees forming a line along the horizon to the left, with lighter green deciduous trees and bushes near the houses on the right.
A single-story house with a gabled roof and porch visible on the right side of the image, surrounded by trees.
An expansive, heavy, dark grey cloud formation dominates the upper half of the image, suggesting severe weather or a fire plume.
